items.summary: Recommendation: queue three bounded, reversible SEO improvements on deeppenetrations.com, broadwayshowgirls.com, and stinkyleftfoot.com while preserving the existing Great American Lakes measurement gate and keeping SearchWoot private. The 30-day SEO window shows 511 impressions at position 4.3 for deeppenetrations.com, 55 impressions at position 1.9 for broadwayshowgirls.com, and 323 impressions at position 13.5 for stinkyleftfoot.com. Amazon reported $4.92 commission on 2026-09-21, but site-level margin and ROI are not calculable because attribution is incomplete and one tracking ID is unmapped. The main unknown is whether snippet and internal-link improvements increase qualified clicks or conversions. Smallest next step: capture baselines, implement the three reversible changes, and measure at 14 days or 100 new impressions with rollback if guardrails regress. Owner question: for SearchWoot, choose A) keep private pending all gates (recommended), or B) authorize preparation—but not sending—of a written Woot permission request.
